Weather Service#

Weather Service Module

This module provides the WeatherService class responsible for:

  • Fetching weather data from the Open-Meteo API.

  • Updating weather conditions for scheduled events.

  • Using a background scheduler to refresh data every 3 hours.

  • Implementing a robust HTTP request retry mechanism.

class WeatherService(db_session, cache_time=3)[source]

Bases: object

A service to retrieve and manage weather data.

This class: - Fetches weather forecasts from the Open-Meteo API. - Updates weather conditions for scheduled events. - Schedules periodic weather updates in the background. - Implements a retry mechanism for API requests.

DEW_POINT_THRESHOLD_LOW = 5.0
DEW_POINT_THRESHOLD_HIGH = 10.0
IDEAL_VISIBILITY = 20000.0

shutdown()[source]

Gracefully shuts down the background scheduler.

Safe to call twice: an explicit shutdown (e.g. test teardown) can race with the atexit hook also registered in __init__, and APScheduler raises if shutdown() runs on an already-stopped scheduler.

static _generate_hourly_range(start, end, tz_str)[source]

Generate a list of hourly timestamps between start and end, inclusive. Ensures that the datetimes are timezone-aware and in the specified timezone.

A naive start/end is assumed to already represent UTC (the convention for every naive datetime in this app - see Event.start_time), not local wall-clock time in tz_str. Attaching tz_str directly to a naive value here would silently reinterpret the UTC hour as a local hour, shifting the whole range by the zone’s UTC offset.

Parameters:

  • start (datetime) – The start datetime.

  • end (datetime) – The end datetime.

  • tz_str (str) – Timezone string (e.g., ‘UTC’, ‘Europe/Rome’).

Returns:

Hourly datetime objects covering the entire period.

Return type:

List[datetime]
